name: windows-runner
description: A local-first, desktop coding agent you run with your own API keys. Windows Runner.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace packages/server && npm run build --workspace packages/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/server && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspace packages/server && npm run test --workspace packages/web
